tasks.title: Update plan [r]un to call native run
tasks.description:
In src/commands/plan.ts, the reviewTasksLoop function's [r]un handler currently calls shellFallbackFn('run', []) (line ~624). Change this to call the native runRun() function directly.

Changes:
- Update the ShellFallbackFn type or add a new RunFn type for the injectable dependency
- In reviewTasksLoop, replace shellFallbackFn('run', []) with a call to the native run function
- In runPlan() (line ~765-770), update the lazy-loaded dependency injection to provide the native run function instead of shellFallback
- The injectable dependency pattern already supports this — just swap what gets injected

Update test/commands/plan.test.ts:
- Update mocks to reflect the new dependency type
- Verify that [r]un menu option calls the native run function
tasks.notes: Replaced shellFallbackFn with runFn (type: () => void | Promise<void>) in ReviewTasksLoopOpts and RunPlanOpts. In runPlan(), the lazy-loaded closure now calls runRun() with loadConfig(projectRoot) to get config. All 106 plan tests pass.

tasks.title: Verify bun build --compile with run + narrate
tasks.description:
Verify that the compiled binary includes and correctly dispatches the new run and narrate commands.

Steps:
1. Run 'bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile dist/ralph' (the existing build script)
2. Test the binary: dist/ralph --version, dist/ralph --help
3. Verify 'dist/ralph run --help' shows the run command with [max] argument
4. Verify 'dist/ralph narrate --help' shows the narrate command with <action> argument
5. Verify that no shell fallback commands remain (SHELL_FALLBACK_COMMANDS should be empty)
6. Run the full test suite: bun test
7. If any issues found, fix them and re-verify

This is a validation task — the goal is to catch any compilation or runtime issues before the phase is considered complete.
